rows.epistemic_note: The exponent 4 is a conditional characterization theorem (declared deep-regime scale covariance and quadrature source composition); neither premise nor a0 is source-derived. The fitted exponent is the reciprocal of an ordinary least-squares slope of log v_f on log M_b; ordinary least squares with error in the regressor attenuates that slope, so the estimator is biased and this is not a calibrated test. The paper displays 3.75 +/- 0.10; the receipt bootstrap standard deviation of the exponent is 0.093 and the receipt values are used here.
